topic: Delhi's AQI crossed *400*, and half its
hook: Delhi's AQI crossed *400*, and half its monitors went silent
hook_b: Delhi's AQI crossed *400*, and half its monitors went silent
tldr: Delhi's air slipped into 'severe' after Diwali; Hindustan Times calls it the 3rd worst Diwali since 2021.

beats.what: The CPCB reported AQI 406 at ITO. Smog spread to Mumbai, Lucknow and other cities, The Hindu reports.
beats.why: More than half the air quality stations in the capital stopped reporting around midnight (Hindustan Times).
beats.care: Delhi-region readers: check official AQI before outdoor plans; treat gaps in data as unknown, not as clean air.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Times of India: visibility was greatly reduced as thick smog covered the city early morning.

cards.q: Did you burst crackers this Diwali?

viz.verdict: Data gaps hide the full picture
